text: `enforceFlagGroupsForCompletion` first returns when flag parsing is disabled (`flag_groups.go:225-228`). Group processing reads each flag's annotations, ignores a group unless all its flags exist, initializes member states, and records each member's `Changed` status (`flag_groups.go:121-142`). Its documented mutually-exclusive behavior is to hide the other group members when one is present, allowing normal completion filtering to enforce the group (`flag_groups.go:220-224,273`).
